title: process_dio compares DODAGVersionNumber across different DODAGIDs when unjoined
description:
## Location

python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py DodagState.process_dio version gate (lines 210-216).

RFC 6550 Section 3.1.2 / 7.2: DODAGVersionNumber scope is a single DODAG (the tuple (RPLInstanceID, DODAGID, DODAGVersionNumber)). Comparing versions of two different DODAGs is undefined.

## What goes wrong

For a joined node, foreign instance/DODAG DIOs return early (lines 205-208). For an UNJOINED node those filters do not run. The next thing process_dio does is lollipop-compare dio.version against the leftover local version. If the local placeholder is lollipop-newer, the DIO is dropped as stale and the unjoined-foreign adopt branch (lines 214-216) never runs.

Trigger:
1. Node joined DODAG fd00::1 at version 10, then lost every parent (select_parent sets role=UNJOINED but leaves version=10).
2. The only remaining advertisement is DODAG fd00::2 version 4 (or any version lollipop-older than 10), same RPLInstanceID.
3. version_is_newer(4, 10) is False; version_is_newer(10, 4) is True; process_dio returns.
4. The node stays UNJOINED forever even though lines 214-216 exist specifically to let unjoined nodes adopt a different DODAG.

A never-joined node constructed with version=10 vs a foreign DODAG at version 1 has the same outcome. The reverse accident also happens: foreign DODAG version 11 is adopted because 11>10, not because DODAG selection chose it.

C lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio adopts whenever !is_joined, without a stale-version veto. Python intends the same (the unjoined ID-mismatch adopt exists) but the stale check runs first and is keyed on a counter that is not comparable across DODAGIDs.

This is distinct from project-LICHEN-worker6-ttfo.2 / .4 (incomparable SAME-DODAG versions falling through as equal).

## Fix

Do not apply version_is_newer / stale rejection until the DIO is known to be the same (rpl_instance_id, dodag_id). For an unjoined node hearing a different DODAG, either adopt without a version comparison or ignore the DIO by policy — do not mix the two by comparing leftover versions.
close_reason: Unjoined foreign (instance,DODAGID) adopts without version-comparing leftover placeholder. test_unjoined_foreign_dodag_is_not_version_compared.
